ROOT.scriptdef: if exists (select name from sysobjects where name = 'KsiKursyZapisuKB' and type = 'P') drop procedure CDN.KsiKursyZapisuKB;

CREATE PROCEDURE CDN.KsiKursyZapisuKB @GIDNumer int, @ParID int = 0 AS select convert(decimal(15,2),isnull(sum(KwotaWal),0)) as KwotaWal, convert(decimal(15,2),isnull(sum(KwotaSys),0)) as KwotaSys, convert(decimal(15,2),isnull(sum(PozostajeZWyc),0)) as PozostajeZWyc, convert(decimal(15,2),isnull(sum(PozostajeZWycSys),0)) as PozostajeZWycSys, convert(int,isnull(max(WycenaID),0)) as WycenaID, convert(decimal(7,2),isnull(max(KursL),0)) as KursL, convert(decimal(5),isnull(max(KursM),0)) as KursM from ( select sum(R2_KwotaWal1) as KwotaWal, sum(R2_KwotaSys) as KwotaSys, sum(R2_PozostajeZWyc) as PozostajeZWyc, sum(R2_PozostajeZWycSys) as PozostajeZWycSys, R2_ParID as WycenaID, max(isnull(KAZ_KursL,0)) as KursL, max(isnull(KAZ_KursM,0)) as KursM from cdn.Rozliczenia left join cdn.Zapisy on R2_Dok2Typ = 784 and R2_Dok2Numer = KAZ_GIDNumer and R2_Dok2Lp = 0 where R2_Dok1Typ = 784 and R2_Dok1Numer = @GIDNumer and R2_Dok1Lp = 0 and R2_Wycena = 1 and (@ParID = 0 or R2_ParID = @ParID) group by R2_ParID union all select sum(R2_KwotaWal2) as KwotaWal, sum(R2_KwotaSys) as KwotaSys, sum(R2_PozostajeZWyc) as PozostajeZWyc, sum(R2_PozostajeZWycSys) as PozostajeZWycSys, R2_ParID as WycenaID, max(isnull(KAZ_KursL,0)) as KursL, max(isnull(KAZ_KursM,0)) as KursM from cdn.Rozliczenia left join cdn.Zapisy on R2_Dok1Typ = 784 and R2_Dok1Numer = KAZ_GIDNumer and R2_Dok1Lp = 0 where R2_Dok2Typ = 784 and R2_Dok2Numer = @GIDNumer and R2_Dok2Lp = 0 and R2_Wycena = 1 and (@ParID = 0 or R2_ParID = @ParID) group by R2_ParID ) a group by WycenaID
GRANT EXECUTE ON CDN.KsiKursyZapisuKB TO CDNRaport
